summary.text: TJ Rose is a Republican member of the Kansas Senate representing District 35 (Johnson County), and the Legislature's member page lists service in the Senate since 2025.

paragraphs.text: TJ Rose is listed as a member of the Education Committee, the Financial Institutions and Insurance Committee, the Judiciary Committee and the Public Health and Welfare Committee.
The Legislature lists TJ Rose's occupation as Insurance Agent.
The page names Sarah Rose as TJ Rose's spouse.
